groups.title: D16 — formatRange drops O and long zone-name widths (ICU-20548)
groups.trigger: an ICU release that fixes ICU-20548 is bundled by GMT's engines.node floor (>=22.16.0) and by every browser the native suite runs, so every D16 repro passes on every engine: this check reports Node, and the weekly run's compat check in each browser (the temporal-compat-chromium, -firefox, -webkit and -webkit-macos verdicts) reports the rest; D16 is removable only when all of them say so

groups.title: D17 — formatRange writes AM/PM for a flexible dayPeriod next to a timeZoneName (SpiderMonkey)
groups.trigger: the weekly run's compat check in Firefox (the temporal-compat-firefox verdict) reports D17 removable: every D17 repro passes in the Firefox the native suite runs, once Bugzilla 2085525 ships. Firefox is the only engine in D17's scope; this check runs on Node, where D17 is out of scope and never removable

groups.title: D19 — ZonedDateTime#equals answers false for two identifiers of one zone where resolvedOptions keeps the identifier (JavaScriptCore)
groups.trigger: a temporal-polyfill release whose TimeZoneEquals finds the primary identifier on a host whose Intl.DateTimeFormat#resolvedOptions returns the identifier as written, so the D19 probe (Etc/UTC equals UTC, ECMA-402 §6.5) passes in the WebKit the native suite runs: the weekly run's compat check in WebKit (the temporal-compat-webkit and temporal-compat-webkit-macos verdicts, Linux and macOS) reports it. WebKit is the only engine in D19's scope; this check runs on Node, where D19 is out of scope and never removable

groups.title: D22 — a zoned relativeTo or start in a repeated hour is measured from the wrong instant, so total, round and until in a date unit answer wrongly from the later pass, and wrongly or not at all from the earlier pass when the end falls in the later pass at a lower wall clock; where a TC39 Assert fails no value exists (tc39/proposal-temporal#3336), including after a skipped hour, and GMT returns its sentinel where the polyfill extrapolates
groups.trigger: a temporal-polyfill release on which every D22 repro passes, P7D with largestUnit "week" giving P1W among them, and which gives no value in totalsWithNoValue, noDayCorrection and emptyDaySpan, where TC39 Asserts (tc39/proposal-temporal#3336); if #3336 gives these lengths a value instead, the rows, the throws and the repros change together

groups.title: D23 — formatToParts and formatRangeToParts abort V8 on a week-of-year year field (nodejs/node#67076)
groups.trigger: every V8 the check reads (Node at the engines.node floor, and the temporal-compat-chromium verdict) passes the D23 repro: a gd formatter with year numeric and month short resolves a year, and the Node child-process confirmation of scripts/canary/weekYear.mjs exits 0 with a year part

groups.title: D24 — CLDR date patterns print the week-of-year year where the calendar year is meant (internal/weekYearGuard.ts)
groups.trigger: every engine's compat verdict passes every D24 repro, and the weekly sweep of scripts/canary/weekYear.mjs flags no locale, calendar or option set

groups.title: D25 — the japanese calendar prints Japanese eras before 1873-01-01 (internal/yearPrinting.ts)
groups.trigger: every engine's compat verdict passes both D25 repros: en-u-ca-japanese prints 2 BC for ISO -0001-07-10 and 1872 AD for 1872-12-31 (tc39/proposal-intl-era-monthcode#86, tc39/test262#4877)

groups.title: D26 — an islamic calendar prints a negative year before the Hijra (internal/yearPrinting.ts)
groups.trigger: every engine's compat verdict passes the D26 repro: en-u-ca-islamic-civil prints a different era text for ISO 600-07-10 and 2025-07-10

groups.title: D27 — ja japanese leaves the era year unpadded under year 2-digit and in Latin digits under another numbering system (internal/yearPrinting.ts, internal/japaneseNumerals.ts)
groups.trigger: every engine's compat verdict passes both D27 repros: ja-u-ca-japanese with year 2-digit prints 令和06年 for 2024-07-10, and ja-u-ca-japanese-nu-arab with year numeric prints 令和٦年

groups.title: D28 — chinese and dangi pad the related year under year 2-digit (internal/yearPrinting.ts)
groups.trigger: every engine's compat verdict passes the D28 repro: en-u-ca-chinese with year 2-digit prints the related year 5 for ISO 0005-07-10

groups.title: D29 — a range drops, repeats or garbles a field of one date (internal/rangeFields.ts)
groups.trigger: every engine's compat verdict passes every D29 repro (rangeFieldRepros.ts, one range per upstream defect, so the gate stays on while any one fails), and the weekly sweep of scripts/canary/rangeFields.mjs flags no locale, calendar or option set

groups.title: D30 — islamic and islamic-rgsa resolve as written (internal/formatterCache.ts)
groups.trigger: every engine's compat verdict passes both D30 repros: en-u-ca-islamic resolves islamic-tbla and en-u-ca-islamic-rgsa resolves a calendar other than islamic-rgsa (tc39/proposal-intl-era-monthcode#99)

groups.title: D31 — a coptic date before AM 1 prints 1 - year and no era (internal/copticEra.ts)
groups.trigger: every engine's compat verdict passes the D31 repro: en-u-ca-coptic prints the signed year -285 and the same era name as a later date for ISO -0001-07-10 (ICU-23277; unicode-org/icu#4081)

groups.title: D32 — the Islamic era changes in the middle of 1 Muharram of year 1 (internal/islamicEpochEra.ts)
groups.trigger: the weekly run's compat check in WebKit (the temporal-compat-webkit and temporal-compat-webkit-macos verdicts) passes the D32 repro: islamic-civil, islamic-tbla and islamic-umalqura print the same era at the first and the last hour of their epoch day in UTC (WebKit 331724)

groups.title: D33 — Chinese and Dangi dates differ by host; a runtime whose probe fails returns the sentinel for a chinese or dangi date format (internal/lunisolarRefusal.ts)
groups.trigger: every engine's compat verdict (Node, chromium, firefox, webkit, webkit-macos) passes every D33 text repro: the host's Intl.DateTimeFormat gives the Purple Mountain Observatory and KASI dates, so 2027-02-06 is the Chinese New Year and 2027-02-07 the Dangi one on every host (Intl era/monthCode §1.1 Table 1)

groups.title: D34 — the Coptic era changes in the middle of 1 Tout AM 1 (internal/copticEra.ts)
groups.trigger: the weekly run's compat check in WebKit (the temporal-compat-webkit and temporal-compat-webkit-macos verdicts) passes the D34 repro: en-u-ca-coptic prints the same era at the first and the last hour of ISO 0284-08-29 in UTC (WebKit/WebKit#81144, bug 331724)

groups.title: D9 — an out-of-range non-ISO month amount throws only after work linear in the amount (temporalCompat/monthRange.ts throws first)
groups.trigger: a temporal-polyfill release throws for an out-of-range month amount in bounded time: hebrew 2024-01-15 + 40,000,000 months throws in at most 5,000 ms (an absolute ceiling that fails the repro at once), and + 400,000,000 months throws in under 3 × the time of + 40,000,000 months + 10 ms
